_artifact_note: Demonstrational artifact. This confirmation applies to the M16-03 dataset-context example artifacts. It is not production validation evidence and must not promote any example to an active association instance without an explicit future authorization.
supplementary_tool_available: jsonschema 4.26.0 (available in project environment via registry/validate.py, publisher/evidence.py)

examples_reviewed.expected_failure_reason: Additional properties are not allowed. 'run_id' is not a declared property. Schema enforces additionalProperties: false.

valid_example_checks.schema_constraint: schema_version is required and must be a string matching semver pattern ^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$.
dataset_slug is required, must match ^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$, and must correspond to a published registry slug.
title is required and must be a non-empty string.
description is required and must be a non-empty string.
valid_example_checks.observed_value: Customer churn prediction dataset for a telecommunications provider. Predicts whether a customer will churn based on service usage and account features.

valid_example_checks.schema_constraint: domain is required and must be a non-empty string.
tags is optional. When present, must be an array of non-empty strings.
short_narrative is optional. When present, must be a non-empty string.
long_narrative is optional. When present, must be a non-empty string.
additionalProperties: false. Only schema_version, dataset_slug, title, description, domain, tags, short_narrative, long_narrative are permitted.
No internal evidence identifiers (run_id, preparation_id, pipeline_id, raw_metrics, batch_id) may appear in a valid example.
Example content must be derived from real published dataset values, not synthetic placeholders.

invalid_example_checks.schema_constraint: 'domain' is listed in the schema's 'required' array. A payload that omits 'domain' must be rejected.
additionalProperties: false. 'run_id' is not declared in the schema's properties and must be rejected.
invalid_example_checks.expected_error: Additional properties are not allowed ('run_id' was unexpected).

outcome_notes: The valid example (dataset-context.example.json) satisfies all schema constraints analytically. Both invalid counterexamples fail in their expected, distinct ways: the missing-required counterexample fails for an absent required field; the internal-field counterexample fails for an additional property prohibited by additionalProperties: false.
